title: Ask these 3 Questions with Hotel Check in Staff for the Best Family Stay with the Kids…Ever!
description:
Ever checked into a hotel with excited kids…
and 10 minutes later someone is crying because the room is tiny, dark, and right next to the lift? 😩

We’ve been there.

Tired from a long flight.
Kids hungry.
Parents just wanting ONE smooth moment.

That’s when we learned something important.
The magic of your stay often starts at the check in desk. ✨

Here are the 3 questions we always ask hotel staff for the best family stay ever:

1️⃣ “Do you have any complimentary room upgrades available for families?”
You’ll be surprised how often the answer is yes, especially if you ask kindly and smile.

2️⃣ “Is there a quieter room away from elevators or busy streets?”
Sleep is everything when traveling with kids. A quiet floor can change your whole trip.

3️⃣ “Are there any family perks or amenities we should know about?”
Sometimes there are free kids meals, welcome treats, late checkout, activity packs or pool access perks that they don’t automatically mention.

One time, we asked these simple questions and ended up with a corner room, extra space for the kids, and a surprise dessert waiting inside. 🍰
The kids still talk about that “fancy hotel cake.”

Here’s a fun trivia for you 🤍
The word “hotel” comes from the French word “hôtel,” which originally meant a large townhouse for important families. From the beginning, hotels were meant to make families feel special and cared for.

So don’t be shy.
You are not being difficult.
You are creating a better memory for your kids.

Because family travel is not just about the destination.
It’s about how safe, rested, and happy everyone feels at the end of the day. 🛏️💛

If you want hotel room upgrades, exclusive perks and freebies comment HOTEL and we’ll send you the link to download our email script we send to hotel few days before we arrive.

And if you want to support our mission of helping more kids travel safer, please make sure to check our website KidsFlyer™ safety travel outfit for kids at www.kidsflyer.com ✈️🧡
